title: Kabla sijaenda nyumbani, ninafungua miongozo ya kesho

text.Before I go home, I open tomorrow’s manu: Kabla sijaenda nyumbani, ninafungua miongozo ya kesho
text.The manuals I use change between the day: Miongozo ninayotumia hubadilika kati ya zamu ya mchana na zamu ya usiku.
text.So before I go home, I roughly imagine t: Kwa hivyo kabla sijaenda nyumbani, mimi hufikiria kazi ya kesho.
text.I paste the links of the manuals I will: Ninabandika viungo vya miongozo ambayo labda nitatumia hapo juu, kisha naenda nyumbani.
text.It feels like leaving a note for the me: Ninahisi kama kuniachia dokezo la kesho asubuhi.
text.I got a sticker for asking a question th: Nilipata kibandiko cha kuuliza swali ambalo liligeuka kuwa kosa
text.I stopped remembering the manuals, and k: Niliacha kukumbuka miongozo, na kuweka viungo tu
